title: Meet Tessa
body: Tessa answers every records and bill request law firms send a 4-clinic injury practice. Here is her Tuesday before and after this desk.

title: Every request in one list
body: Requests from portals, fax and email together, with the firm, the due date and where each one stands. Click a row to open its history.

title: The request history
body: Each step on the request in order: matched chart, authorization check, pages pulled, bill and balance, release.

title: A birth date that matches no chart
body: Two patients share this name, and the authorization's birth date matches neither. It is flagged before any pages are pulled, so the wrong chart never goes out.

title: Time left before the firm's due date
body: The countdown shows how long until the firm needs the packet, so the most urgent problem is fixed first.

title: Tessa approves, then records go out
body: Each packet shows the chart, date range, pages, itemized bill and balance. Nothing is released to a firm until Tessa approves it.

title: What this work costs today
body: Put in your own request volume and staff rate to compare today's cost with the desk.

title: How it would be built
body: Click any box to see what it does, what data passes through it and whether it stores patient data. Portal requests and chart data meet in the practice's own cloud; the AI reader sees authorization text only.
